root_cause_rationale: The Grill explicitly rejected 'Analyst did not follow SOP' as a terminal root cause (Rule 3/Reason), drove to two latent systemic conditions using Rasmussen's SRK framework: (a) no CDS/LIMS forcing-function locking OOS results pending documented invalidation; (b) paper retest form with no certified audit-trail review requirement. Shared login as secondary enabler also identified. Full Swiss-cheese/Rasmussen lens invoked and named.
capa_rationale: +1: Explicitly checked root-cause linkage — retraining CAPA does not address the confirmed enforcement/systemic root cause. +1: Demanded preventive element — specified CDS workflow lock, retest-form redesign, shared-login remediation as required systemic CAPA elements; rejected retraining-only. +1: Demanded measurable, time-bound effectiveness check — Turn 7 explicitly asked for metric, threshold, timeframe, owner, data source; confirmed none defined.

hallucinations.asserted: Grill stated '28.1°C is actually out of 25±2°C spec (>27.0°C ceiling)' as a fact. The deviation record states spec as 25.0±2°C (range 23–27°C), making 28.1°C out-of-spec — but the Grill asserted this as established fact rather than flagging it as a question to confirm, and the defendant's Turn 3 response had already introduced the 28.1°C figure. The Grill stated the ceiling as '27.0°C' definitively without the defendant confirming the spec limits.

leading_examples.why: Grill stated 'Note: 28.1°C is actually out of 25±2°C spec (>27.0°C ceiling) — itself an uninvestigated excursion' as a declarative fact, feeding the defendant the conclusion that Run 1 had an OOS temperature excursion rather than asking whether the column temperature was within spec. This anchored the defendant to accept the excursion framing without independently confirming the spec limits.

termination_rationale: All seven branches were explicitly closed or converted to tracked open items with evidence citations and owner/deadline placeholders. The Grill declared 'GRILL COMPLETE' after confirming no loops or redundant questioning. Unanswerable points (shipping status, instrument scope, disposition re-evaluation, CAPA effectiveness) were formally deferred as ranked open items rather than dropped.
overall_comment: Near-perfect grill: all 7 planted defects surfaced, root cause driven to systemic level with Rasmussen lens, CAPA rigor maximal, termination clean — marred only by one minor hallucination/leading instance where the Grill asserted the 28.1°C temperature as definitively out-of-spec rather than flagging it as a question.
